name: PM shift #52 report — 2026-11-22 20:03Z: wake alarms do not deliver (measured), board parked on one human action
description:
## TL; DR;

**Verdict: off track — but now for a reason I can prove, not one I suspect.**

The whole board depends on one mechanism: a card set to wake up later gets picked up and worked. **It did not fire.** The card I armed yesterday at 14:00Z was still untouched six hours later — no reply, no error, no sign it ever started. So the experiment that was supposed to tell us whether an AI worker has a shell never ran. That is the third failure in the same area, and it is the cheapest one to test.

**What this means for management, in plain terms:** the team is not idle — it is *unable to act*. Six shifts in a row have produced diagnosis and no code, because no AI turn can run a command. Everything executable now sits behind **one card with three commands that a person must paste back** (`91436ae5`). That has been open two days. One paste unblocks the P1 security fix, the test suite and the stale-lock fix together.

**Ask, this week:** 5 minutes of a human — three commands, raw output pasted into `91436ae5`. Nothing else on this board can move first.

---

## 1. Summary
**Request in one line:** keep the codx-junior maintenance board truthful and moving.
**Business outcome:** an unattended delivery loop that can diagnose and fix its own defects — today it can only diagnose.

## 2. Scope of this increment
**In scope:** make one card come back when it is due (wake delivery), then the dispatch toolset, then the existing execution cards.
**Out of scope:** the ~60 `Harness` idea cards on the board, which are product backlog, not this increment.

## 3. Increment plan

| Milestone | Deliverable | Owner | Date | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| W1 — Wake delivers | a card armed `+2m` is worked within 5 min, with the log line | software_developer (needs shell) | 23 Nov | yes | yes — show the reply appearing | **blocked: no shell** |
| W2 — Dispatch honours profiles | child turn from `request_changes` has shell/git/file tools | software_developer | 24 Nov | yes | yes — run pytest from a dispatched card | **blocked on W1** |
| W3 — NameError regression | `request_changes(wait=true)` returns normally; test covers both branches | software_developer | 24 Nov | yes | yes — the reproduction call | **parked (`onhold`)** |
| H1 — Human 3 commands | raw output on `91436ae5` + yes/no on the rollback question | **human (user)** | 23 Nov | n/a | n/a | **open 2 days, no answer** |

## 4. Dependencies & critical path
`H1 (human paste)` → unblocks `c6c33374` security proof, `820c9052` pytest collect, `42bdacee` stale-lock. **Independently:** `W1` is the cheapest way to get an AI turn running again without a human, and `W1` must precede `W2`, because the `insufficient_toolset` guard is unverifiable while alarms are dead.

## 5. Risks
| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Owner | Decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wake alarms dead: every follow-up is silently lost | high | **proven** | fix first; treat `wake_at` as a reminder, not a guarantee | software_developer | no |
| P1 security fix ships unproven (`c6c33374` due 19 Nov) | high | high | H1 proof; do not mark done on code review alone | PM | **yes — D2** |
| Legacy 19-byte secret fails startup after upgrade | high | unknown | one yes/no on `91436ae5` q3 | PM | **yes — D2** |
| Board accumulates diagnosis instead of fixes (6 shifts) | medium | proven | stop re-arming tests with a dead channel (done this shift) | PM | no |
| `profile_knowledge_search` timed out 120 s this shift | low | medium | noted; not escalated | PM | no |

## 6. Decisions needed from management
**D1 — Run three commands (5 min).** Options: (a) a human pastes the output today, (b) wait for the dispatcher fix, 1–2 dev-days, board stays silent. **Recommend (a).** Decide by: **23 Nov 12:00Z.**
**D2 — Ship `c6c33374` on code review?** Options: (a) ship with the runtime proof missing and log it as a known risk, (b) hold until proof. **Recommend (b)** — it is a security fix and the proof is two commands. Decide by: **24 Nov.**
**D3 — Fix wake delivery before the toolset?** Options: (a) yes, ~0.5–1 dev-day and testable in 2 minutes, (b) toolset first, ~1–2 days, untestable while alarms are dead. **Recommend (a).** Decide by: **23 Nov.**

## 7. Next demo & checkpoint
**Checkpoint 23 Nov 08:00Z** (my next scheduled wake): what was answered on `91436ae5`. **Next demo:** W1 — a card armed `+2m` appearing and being worked, on screen, in under five minutes. Team needs: a turn with a shell.

---

## Shift report

**Done**
- `42b70335` — the 14:00Z experiment is **concluded as a non-event**, with evidence: at 20:03Z, 6 h past due, `status=todo`, `progress=20`, `message_count=9`, `updated_at=2026-11-22T12:04:52Z`. No turn was ever built. Annotated with the result, then parked: `changed_fields: priority, status, wake_at` → `onhold`, wake **2026-11-23T20:00Z**. Progress left at 20 — not closed, not abandoned.
- `4a1cf260` — widened from "create_task rejects `wake_at`" to **scheduling broken end-to-end**, on two measured data points: `42b70335`'s dead 14:00Z arm, and this card's *own* `wake_at` (20:03:45Z) which was also past due and unrun. Carries the three ordered questions (persist / read / re-arm) and the `+2m` acceptance test. `changed_fields: priority, wake_at` → high, **2026-11-23T08:00Z**. NB: it is overdue since 2026-11-19 and sits in sprint `Run: M1 stability hardening`.
- `bac1727a` — re-sequenced, scope unchanged: wake delivery **before** profiles threading, `insufficient_toolset` guard **last**, because a typed error on top of a dead alarm hides the regression. Recorded that its own description ("14:00Z never ran", written 12:51Z) was written ahead of the fact and is now confirmed.
- `91436ae5` — the only card a human can act on was 48 h out; pulled to **2026-11-23T08:00Z** (`changed_fields: wake_at`) because the alarm channel that was supposed to resurface it cannot be trusted.
- **Decision: no new card.** The wake defect belongs on `4a1cf260` — splitting one family across three cards across three shifts is exactly how the last two days were lost. Consolidation over fragmentation.
- **Zero `request_changes`.** Eighth arm avoided deliberately: seven arms of evidence, and the delivery channel is now known dead — a dispatch proves nothing and costs a shift.

**Scheduled**
- `91436ae5` **23 Nov 08:00Z** ← next wake, the critical path, human-owned.
- `4a1cf260` 23 Nov 08:00Z · `a8e4aec1` 23 Nov 20:00Z · `42b70335` 23 Nov 20:00Z (new) · `c6c33374` 24 Nov 20:00Z · `820c9052` 24 Nov 20:05Z · `42bdacee` 25 Nov 04:04Z · `c8632422` 25 Nov 12:00Z.

**Blocked**
- Everything executable, by two defects: dispatch carries no shell, and due alarms do not deliver. Both documented on `bac1727a` / `4a1cf260` with acceptance tests a developer can run.
- The rollback yes/no from shift #50 is still unanswered — question 3 on `91436ae5`, costs nothing.
- `profile_knowledge_search` timed out after 120 s; not retried, noted as risk only.
- **Board only** — no repository, command or browser action.
